description: This file defines a repository interface for FinancialActivityAccount entities, extending Spring Data JPA repositories, and includes a custom query method to find accounts by financial activity type.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for FinancialActivityAccount entity, providing CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByFinancialActivityType
methods.description: Finds a FinancialActivityAccount by the financial activity type using a JPQL query.

calls: Query("select faa from FinancialActivityAccount faa where faa.financialActivityType = :financialActivityType")
